assets.name: CanopyMask
assets.prompt: Production 2D GAME SHADOW MASK, ONE square 1536x1536. Image 1 is only composition reference for a sunny leafy courtyard. Pure WHITE background everywhere unshadowed; solid BLACK means full shadow, a very narrow gray antialias edge only. Absolutely no colored scene, no actual tree trunks/leaves rendered as objects, no grid, no text. Draw the CAST SHADOW SILHOUETTE of a large broad-leaf tree canopy coming from upper-left and spreading diagonally down-right across roughly x0-65%, y0-48% of canvas, with 5-7 large clustered masses and irregular leaf-shaped holes. Another small faintly separated black leafy silhouette intrudes only at bottom-left x0-20%, y75-100%. Middle/lower-right remain mostly pure white. Broad readable shapes like anime painted background shadows, not thousands of fine leaf speckles. Darkest black regions are a MASK and will be tinted translucent cool green-gray in Unity.
